shots.name: B1-agent-sitting-typing-at-generated-desk
shots.note: (() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); return 'claude ' + e.anim.state + ' posture ' + e.posture + ' at ' + e.spot; })()

shots.name: B2-agent-using-printer
shots.eval: (async () => { const { makeEvent } = await import('/core/events.mjs'); const s = hillinkWorld.store; s.dispatch(makeEvent('TASK_CREATED', { taskId: 'print-1', title: 'Print the review notes' }, { source: 'sim', at: Date.now() })); s.dispatch(makeEvent('TASK_STARTED', { taskId: 'print-1', agentId: 'codex', activity: 'researching', progress: { kind: 'stage', stage: 'Reading' } }, { source: 'sim', at: Date.now() })); return true; })()
shots.note: (() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:codex'); return 'codex ' + e.anim.state + ' using ' + e.spotInfo?.use + ' (' + e.spotInfo?.of + ')'; })()

shots.name: B3-break-room-rest
shots.note: [...hillinkWorld.scene.entities.values()].filter(e => e.kind==='agent').map(e => e.ref.id + ' ' + e.anim?.state + ' ' + e.posture + ' at ' + e.spotInfo?.use).join('; ')

shots.name: C1-agent-riding-generated-elevator
shots.after: (() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); hillinkWorld.camera.focusPoint(e.x, e.y - 60, { zoom: 2.2, duration: 0 }); return true; })()
shots.note: (() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); const l = Object.values(hillinkWorld.theme.layout.lifts)[0]; return 'claude gait ' + e.gait + ', lift ' + l.id + ' floors ' + l.floors.join(','); })()

shots.name: D1-traffic-on-generated-road
shots.after: (() => { const L = hillinkWorld.theme.layout, n = L.navNodes['road-1#' + Math.max(1, Object.keys(L.navNodes).filter(k => k.startsWith('road-1#')).length - 3)]; hillinkWorld.camera.focusPoint(n[0], n[1], { zoom: 1.1, duration: 0 }); return true; })()

shots.name: E02-construction-site-preparation-builder-walking
shots.note: (() => { const e = hillinkWorld.scene.get('agent:claude'); return 'claude ' + e.anim?.state + ' ' + (e.moving ? 'walking to the site' : 'at ' + e.spot); })()
